# Template: venn_diagram
A Venn or Euler set diagram: two or three overlapping circles (or, in containment mode, one small circle entirely inside a larger one — an Euler "All A are B" diagram), an optional universe box, region labels, and approximate shading of any requested region. Choose this scene for ANY request about a Venn diagram, Euler diagram, sets, set intersection, set union, overlapping categories, or "all X are Y" style set containment.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "sets": {
   "type": "array",
   "minItems": 2,
   "maxItems": 3,
   "items": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
     "label": {
      "type": "string"
     },
     "only_label": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Label for this set's own region (the part of it outside every other set)."
     }
    },
    "required": [
     "label"
    ]
   },
   "description": "Two or three sets, in order. In containment mode sets[0] is the inner (subset) circle, sets[1] the outer one."
  },
  "overlap_labels": {
   "type": "object",
   "properties": {
    "ab": {
     "type": "string"
    },
    "bc": {
     "type": "string"
    },
    "ac": {
     "type": "string"
    },
    "abc": {
     "type": "string"
    },
    "outside": {
     "type": "string"
    }
   },
   "description": "Labels for the overlap/outside regions, by key. ab/bc/ac/abc only apply with 3 sets except ab, which also names the full intersection with 2 sets."
  },
  "shade": {
   "type": "array",
   "items": {
    "type": "string",
    "enum": [
     "a",
     "b",
     "c",
     "ab",
     "bc",
     "ac",
     "abc",
     "outside"
    ]
   },
   "description": "Which regions to approximately shade."
  },
  "universe_box": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Draw a rectangle around everything, representing the universal set (default true)."
  },
  "mode": {
   "type": "string",
   "enum": [
    "overlap",
    "containment"
   ],
   "description": "overlap (default): circles overlap in the usual Venn layout. containment: exactly 2 sets, sets[0] drawn entirely inside sets[1] — the Euler diagram for \"all A are B\"."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- universe: the rectangle representing the universal set, present when universe_box
- set_<i>: the circle for sets[i]
- set_label_<i>: its name label
- region_label_<k>: a region's label (k = a/b/c for a set's own-only region from its only_label, or ab/bc/ac/abc/outside from overlap_labels), present only when that label is supplied
- shade_<k>: approximate shading for region k, present only for keys in `shade`
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw a Venn diagram of two sets and shade their intersection." → params: {"sets":[{"label":"A"},{"label":"B"}],"shade":["ab"],"overlap_labels":{"ab":"A ∩ B"}}
Request: "Show that all squares are rectangles with an Euler diagram." → params: {"mode":"containment","sets":[{"label":"Squares"},{"label":"Rectangles"}]}

In YAML: `template: venn_diagram` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
